```{r boxplot function}

BoxPlot <- function(object, features, group.by = NULL, group.order = NULL, pt.size = 0.1, add.jitter = FALSE, angle = 45, ...) {
  require(Seurat)
  require(ggplot2)

  # Extract data
  data <- FetchData(object, vars = c(features, group.by))
  
  # If no group.by provided, use 'ident'
  if (is.null(group.by)) {
    data[[group.by]] <- Idents(object)
    group.by <- "ident"
  }

  # Clean column names
  colnames(data)[1] <- "feature"
  colnames(data)[2] <- "group"
  
  # Set factor levels for custom group order if provided
  if (!is.null(group.order)) {
    data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = group.order)
  } else {
    data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = unique(data$group))
  }

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = group, y = feature, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, ...) +
    theme_classic() +
    xlab(group.by) +
    ylab(features) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = angle, hjust = 1))
  
  # Optionally add jittered points
  if (add.jitter) {
    p <- p + geom_jitter(size = pt.size, width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6)
  }

  return(p)
}


```
